heatingElements.name: Bare Coiled Nichrome (NiCr 80/20)
heatingElements.description: Exposed coiled 80% nickel / 20% chromium resistance wire. High infrared emissivity and instant thermal response, but thermal cycling and vibration induce micro-spallation of Cr2O3 oxide scale directly above the conveyor belt.

heatingElements.name: Sheathed Calrod Tubular Incoloy 800
heatingElements.cr6Potential: Zero (Internal resistance coil sealed in MgO powder)
heatingElements.description: Resistance wire embedded in compacted magnesium oxide (MgO) dielectric insulation inside a seamless Incoloy alloy sheath. Eliminates metal spallation into food, providing uniform heat and superior commercial durability.

heatingElements.name: Quartz Halogen Infrared Tube
heatingElements.cr6Potential: Zero (Tungsten filament enclosed in hermetic quartz glass)
heatingElements.description: High-intensity medium-wave infrared radiation passing through high-purity quartz envelopes. Deep penetration into bread crust with zero particulate emission, but extreme radiative flux requires precise conveyor speed calibration.

heatingElements.name: FeCrAl (Kanthal A-1) Open Coil
heatingElements.cr6Potential: Low (Forms protective adherent Al2O3 alumina scale)
heatingElements.description: Iron-chromium-aluminum alloy. Forms an adherent alumina oxide film rather than chromium oxide, significantly reducing hexavalent chromium volatility, but susceptible to mechanical embrittlement over repeated thermal cycles.

conveyorSpeeds.name: Express Bun Cycle (15 Seconds)
conveyorSpeeds.typicalUse: Fast-food burger buns, English muffins, rapid breakfast rush

conveyorSpeeds.name: Standard Toast Cycle (30 Seconds)
conveyorSpeeds.typicalUse: Sliced sandwich bread, standard diner breakfast service

conveyorSpeeds.name: Dense Bagel / Heavy Crust Cycle (60 Seconds)
conveyorSpeeds.typicalUse: Dense bagels, artisan thick-cut bread, frozen Texas toast

conveyorSpeeds.name: Conveyor Jam / Stalled Dwell (120 Seconds)
conveyorSpeeds.typicalUse: Accidental chain motor slip or chute jam resulting in pyrolysis

breadMatrices.name: Enriched Brioche Bun (High Sugar & Dairy Lipids)
breadMatrices.description: High sucrose and reducing sugar content accelerates Maillard non-enzymatic browning at temperatures as low as 140°C, generating steep acrylamide spikes.

breadMatrices.name: Commercial White Sandwich Bread
breadMatrices.description: Standard wheat flour with moderate reducing sugars and high free asparagine. Baseline reference for commercial EU and FDA toast benchmarks.

breadMatrices.name: Traditional Fermented Sourdough (Low pH 4.4)
breadMatrices.description: Lactic acid bacterial fermentation depletes free sugars and lowers crumb pH to 4.2–4.5, chemically inhibiting Schiff base formation and reducing acrylamide by 55–65%.

breadMatrices.name: Gluten-Free Rice & Potato Starch Loaf
breadMatrices.description: Potato and refined rice starches exhibit elevated free asparagine and quick crust moisture loss, leading to accelerated acrylamide formation during intense radiant heating.

breadMatrices.name: Dense New York Style Boiled Bagel
breadMatrices.description: Pre-boiling gelatinizes exterior starches into a glassy crust that impedes deep thermal penetration, maintaining core moisture.

crumbTrayStates.name: Sanitized & Cleared Hourly (<5g Crumbs)
crumbTrayStates.description: Crumb tray emptied hourly in accordance with commercial kitchen best practices. Ambient conductive heat stays far below the 200°C pyrolysis onset.

crumbTrayStates.name: Full Shift Buildup (8 Hours, ~180g Crumbs)
crumbTrayStates.description: Radiant heat from bottom elements elevates crumb bed temperature above 200°C, initiating slow thermal decomposition and releasing acrolein fumes into the airflow.

crumbTrayStates.name: Multi-Day Carbonized Crumb Bed (>500g Crumbs + Butter Drippings)
crumbTrayStates.description: Heavily carbonized crumb bed acting as a smoldering combustion source. Continuous generation of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH, benzo[a]pyrene) and particulate matter that re-condenses onto traversing toast.

ventilationStates.name: Dedicated Type II Commercial Exhaust Hood (350+ CFM)
ventilationStates.description: Active ducted mechanical exhaust removes hot thermal plumes, aerosolized chromium oxides, acrolein, and VOCs directly at the toaster ceiling exit.

ventilationStates.name: Buffet Line Countertop (Ambient Room Air Convection)
ventilationStates.description: Passive room air circulation. Fumes, aerosolized sub-micron oxides, and pyrolytic off-gassing escape into the direct customer/staff breathing zone.
